ck: (27)pavapratipa: evan vyavaharikapetasya patyatvapaksan nirasyapatyatvapaksanasankya nirakaroti — yati punariti avivata iti apatyatvanankikare tateva paranartikatvaniti navayorvivatostiti pava evan paroktavyavaharikapetaparatvan srutinanankikrtya patyatvapatyatvavikalpena tusananapihitan itanin tatevanupapananiti pavenaha — kutasceti utaran sankate — atvEteti atvEtasya paranartikatvatatvirutasya petasyapi paranartikatvayokatvyavaharikatvanankikrtya petapetasrutyorvirota pariharisyata iti pava evan tarhi nastvetaya petasrutinanatvEtaparatvan kinana satrsyatyartakatvanevastu evanca petasrutinan paranartikapetaparatvepi natvEtasrutivirota iti pavenaha — kin tarhiti virotapariharasya sanyatiti yata tvEtatvEtasrutyorvirotapraptetvEtasya paranartikatvan tvEtasya vyavaharikatvanapipretya virota parihriyate evan tvEtasyEva paranartikatvanankikrtvatvEtasrute satrsyatyapetartakatvena na tvEtatvEta srutyorvirota ityapi virotapariharasya sanyatityarta nanu svakocarartapato hi prananyaniti yatuktan tatsatyaneva tatapi na petasrute prananyan svakocararto nana svatatparyakocara eva na svapihitanatro petasca na srutitatparyakocara yena tasya patyatvankikare srutinanaprananyan prasacyeta kinana nahan sarvacna ityatipratyaksapraptan petan nisetartananuvatantyeva srutaya iti pavena sankate — nanviti apihitapatepyaprananyan kuto netyata aha — anyateti yati srutyutitasya patacruteraprananyanankikriyate tarhyutana vE tevakava vahantityartavatapakasyaprananyan syat srutyutitasya tevakavananutrvavahitvasya lOkikakosvatrstatvena patitatvat atastatra ninansakanate pratanatyayatrtiyapate prayokacotanapavartakatvanavipakatiti sutravyakyanavasare yacnatravyartatvena tevasanpantino ye nanusyanan kavastatstutiparanevetan vakyanityapipretartanupapatayEva prananyanupapatitaniti pava kecitu sorotityatarotitityartavatesu nantresu ca saktya pratipatitananatatparyavisayiputananartanan patatityarta ityahu vEparityasanpavatiti yatucyate taneti vakyan parihare yuktivisesan ca vina nirninitanapete srutinan nisetakatvasya petasrutinananuvatakatvasyankikare uktaritya vEparityasyapyankikaraprasankatityarta nanu petasrutinan petanatrapratipatakatvatkatanapetanisetaparatvan yena vEparityaprasanka ityata aha — petasyeti peto nananyonyapava sa ca tatatnyapratiyokika tata ca tatrsapetapratipatakasrutinan
